name: vault-anything-rules
description: Tests firestore.rules and storage.rules on the local emulators. Needs Node 20+ and Java 21+.

scripts.test: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore,storage --project demo-vault-anything "node --test --test-concurrency=1 test/rules.test.mjs test/storage.test.mjs test/dates.test.mjs"
